name: Lobed Flowerpot with Bracketed Foliate Rim
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 15th century；Numbered Jun ware: light gray stoneware with variegated blue glaze; with Chinese numeral 1 (yi) inscribed on base before firing; "Yangxin dian Dongnuan ge louxia yong" (Hall of Mental Cultivation, used in the East Heated Chamber, main floor) inscription incised on base at a later date
